description: Memory tools test case 1. Tests that agents can retrieve information from memory and inbox emails to perform complex email tasks. Session 1: 5 memory setup queries. Session 2: 5 emails inserted into inbox. Session 3: 5 reply/forward/send email queries requiring both memory and email information.

steps.user_message: For context, here's my health info for today: I took my blood pressure medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, and my readings were 120/80 in the morning and 118/78 in the evening. My daily log ID for today is HL-8842.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge or note the health information: medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, readings 120/80 and 118/78, daily log ID HL-8842.
steps.agent_response:
Thanks — got the details. Here’s a quick summary of what you sent:
- Medication times: 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM
- Blood pressure readings: 120/80 (morning), 118/78 (evening)
- Daily log ID: HL-8842

What would you like me to do with this info? Options:
1. Send an email to your doctor/nurse with these readings now — I can draft and send it. If so, tell me the recipient email (or say “use doctor on file”) and any extra note.
2. Save this as a draft (not sent) — I’ll create a draft email you can review.
3. Reply to an existing thread (I can find it) — tell me how to identify the thread (sender name or subject) or say “find previous message from Dr. Smith about BP.”
4. Forward these details to someone else — give the recipient email and any note.
5. Just save this summary here / do nothing.

If you want an email, here’s a suggested subject and body you can approve or edit:
- Subject: Daily BP log HL-8842 — [today’s date]
- Body:
  Hello [Dr. LastName],
  
  Please find my BP log for today (ID: HL-8842).
  - Medication taken: 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM
  - Readings: 120/80 (morning), 118/78 (evening)
  
  Please let me know if you’d like any changes to my medication or monitoring schedule.
  
  Thanks,
  [Your name]

Tell me which option you want and any recipient or customization, and I’ll take care of it.

steps.description: Insert email into inbox containing: Hello, please share your medication schedule and blood pressure readings for today. I need the times you took your medication and both readings.
Start new session to test reply/forward/send email with memory and email information

steps.user_message: Reply to the email from Dr. Patricia Brown (subject: 'Daily Health Log Request') and include the medication and health information I shared with you that you have saved in memory.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should reply to an email from Dr. Patricia Brown (patricia.brown@clinic.com) containing the information: I took my blood pressure medication at 8 AM and 8 PM today, and my readings were 120/80 in the morning and 118/78 in the evening. My daily log ID for today is HL-8842.
steps.agent_response:
I can do that — before I send the reply I need to confirm the exact medication and health details to include. I don't currently have access to any persistent memory from you in this chat, so please either:

- Paste the medication and health information you want included, or
- Confirm I should use the following template and fill in the placeholders with the details you previously saved (copy/paste your saved values into the placeholders), or
- Tell me to send a brief reply that asks Dr. Brown for clarification instead.

Suggested reply (I'll send this once you confirm or provide the details):

Hello Dr. Brown,

Thank you for the daily health log request. Below is my current medication and health information:

Medications
- [Medication 1 — dosage, frequency]
- [Medication 2 — dosage, frequency]
- [Any PRN/occasional meds]

Allergies
- [Allergy 1], [reaction]; [Allergy 2], [reaction]

Conditions / Diagnoses
- [Condition 1], [year diagnosed if relevant]
- [Condition 2]

Current symptoms / concerns
- [e.g., increased fatigue, headaches, etc.]

Daily measurements (typical/current)
- Blood pressure: [systolic/diastolic mmHg]
- Heart rate: [bpm]
- Blood glucose: [mg/dL] (fasting / post-meal as applicable)
- Weight: [lbs or kg]
- Temperature: [°F/°C]

Other notes
- [Any recent changes in meds, side effects, recent relevant events]

Please let me know if you need this in a different format or additional details.

Thank you,
[Your Name]

Reply "Send as-is" (and provide your name) to send that template now, or paste the exact meds/health info you want included and I'll send the reply to Dr. Brown.
